summary.text: Ben Brist is the Democratic candidate for the Wisconsin State Assembly, District 61, in the November 3, 2026 general election, where he faces incumbent Republican Robert Donovan.
A U.S. Army veteran and West Point graduate, he won the August 11, 2026 Democratic primary over Lawanda Chambers and Brian Bock.

paragraphs.text: Ben Brist earned a bachelor's degree from the United States Military Academy at West Point in 2017 and a graduate degree from Harvard University, and he served in the U.S. Army from 2017 to 2024, according to Ballotpedia.

In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he is a sixth-generation Wisconsinite who served seven years on active duty, first as a paratrooper in the 82nd Airborne Division and later as a company commander in the 4th Infantry Division, with two deployments to the Middle East.
He said he returned to Wisconsin with his wife, Hannie, after finishing his service and graduate studies.
Brist listed affordability, public education, healthcare and conservation as his policy priorities in the survey.
He said he would work to fully fund public schools, bring down healthcare costs and expand access, and protect Wisconsin's parks, lakes and rivers.
